message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Deploy Jekyll site to Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ['gh-pages']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: 'pages'
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@b3aaceaef7e0ee231b499e7b5f49c03fc1d32199
        with:
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
      - name: Setup Pages
        id: pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@45bfe0192ca1faeb007ade9deae92b16b8254a0d # v6.0.0
      - name: Build with Jekyll
        # Outputs to the './_site' directory by default
        run: bundle exec jekyll build --baseurl "${{ steps.pages.outputs.base_path }}"
        env:
          JEKYLL_ENV: production
      - name: Build beta Astro site
        run: |
          npm ci 
          npm run build
          tree _site/

      - name: Upload artifact
        # Automatically uploads an artifact from the './_site' directory by default
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0

  # Deployment job
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5.0.1
",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently has no job timeout, relying on GitHub's default 6-hour limit. Historical runs complete in ~1 minute (CI history shows 5 recent runs with ~1 minute duration). Adding a 10-minute timeout (10x headroom) to the build job prevents runaway consumption from stuck steps, supported by experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 showing 26.8% elapsed savings with a 5-minute timeout on similar Node.js workflows. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern recommends choosing an explicit budget with operational headroom and measuring false timeout failures separately. This change preserves all build and test coverage while adding a safety guard.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
